results.code: Omission of Mandatory Output Completion Marker
results.why: All findings describe the exact same underlying mechanism: the model fails to include the mandatory terminal completion marker (`[[ ## completed ## ]]`) at the end of its output.

All findings represent the same underlying failure mechanism: the agent introducing external or parametric facts not found in the provided context/passages to generate queries, formulate arguments, or verify claims.

The findings cover two distinct failure mechanisms: prematurely terminating the retrieval process by issuing a 'no query needed' response instead of a search query, and making invalid deductions or misinterpreting facts present in the evidence during reasoning.

parts.name: Premature Retrieval Loop Termination
parts.definition: The agent incorrectly determines that no further context retrieval is necessary and outputs a non-query string indicating completion (such as 'None required' or 'Not applicable') instead of generating the required search query.
parts.when_to_use: Use when an agent halts multi-hop retrieval prematurely by emitting a statement that no search is needed, leaving required hops unexecuted.
parts.when_not_to_use: Do not use when the agent completes query generation but makes logical errors or unwarranted assumptions while reasoning over retrieved passages.

parts.name: Unsound Deductive Reasoning from Context
parts.definition: The agent draws invalid logical conclusions, accepts unevidenced premises, or makes false assertions about context contents (such as claiming evidence is missing or unique when it is not) during evaluation.
parts.when_to_use: Use when the agent's logical reasoning step is flawed, including making ungrounded assumptions, ignoring present evidence, or drawing unsupported conclusions from context.
parts.when_not_to_use: Do not use when the failure is simply the agent outputting a 'no query needed' string during a search step.

results.reason: every pair of parts occurs apart

results.code: False Attribution of Claims to Input Passages
results.why: All findings describe the exact same core failure mechanism: an agent falsely asserting that a specific factual claim is supported, confirmed, or documented by a given input passage (or set of passages) when the passage does not contain that information.
The findings split into two distinct mechanisms: violating explicit numerical count constraints on entity lists versus generating invalid or non-functional search query strings.

parts.name: Invalid Search Query Generation
parts.definition: The agent produces a search query string that is malformed or unsearchable, such as wrapping a full natural language sentence in quotation marks or outputting placeholder/conversational text ('None', 'None required...') instead of a keyword query.
parts.when_to_use: Use when the agent generates search queries that fail to follow query syntax requirements or replaces required search queries with placeholder or conversational text.
parts.when_not_to_use: Do not use when the agent produces valid query syntax but violates exact numerical count constraints in entity lists.

parts.name: Entity List Cardinality Constraint Violation
parts.definition: The agent outputs a list of entity or document titles whose total count violates explicit instructions requiring an exact number of items.
parts.when_to_use: Use when the agent provides too few or too many entity/document titles relative to a explicitly mandated count constraint.
parts.when_not_to_use: Do not use when the error is in the format or content of a search query string.

results.reason: every pair of parts occurs apart

results.code: Omission of Required Output Sections or Headers
results.why: All findings describe the same failure mechanism: the agent failing to include or properly format the required section headers ('Retrieved required evidence documents' and 'Missing required evidence documents') as specified by output instructions. The differences across findings are merely variations in wording and whether one or both required section headers were missing or improperly formatted.
